bookingFaq.headline: The practical answers, before you commit.

items.question: How does a street batch form?
items.answer: The demo groups sample bookings by street, service, and date. In the intended pilot, an operator reviews nearby requests and confirms provider availability, scope, pricing, and timing manually. A second household does not guarantee a discount.

items.question: When am I charged?
items.answer: Blokpakt does not currently authorize cards, collect payments, or send payouts. Demo prices are illustrative. Any future service price and payment arrangement must be agreed before confirmation.

items.question: Is my request a confirmed booking?
items.answer: No. A request requires manual review of the service area, contractor availability, price, and date. In the request pilot, customers can cancel unconfirmed requests; confirmed work and changes are handled by the operator.

items.question: What should I do before the provider arrives?
items.answer: Clear personal items from the work area, secure pets, identify gates and water or power access, and tell us about hazards or restricted areas. Providers can only service areas they can safely access.

items.question: What are common service limitations?
items.answer: Weather, unsafe access, hazardous materials, property size, and work outside the agreed scope can affect availability and pricing. Scope and changes require manual agreement. Online add-on approval and photo uploads are demo features, not live pilot operations.

trustAndSafety.headline: Know what happens next.
trustAndSafety.intro: The intended pilot starts with a request, followed by manual review. Service coverage and contractor availability must be confirmed before any work is agreed.

items.title: A request, not a booking
items.description: Sending a request does not reserve a provider or confirm a service date.

items.title: An agreed scope and quote
items.description: Property details, included work, pricing, and timing require manual agreement.

items.title: Demo and pilot stay separate
items.description: Sample providers, prices, photos, and bookings are not real service records.

reporting.title: What about photos and service changes?
reporting.description: Photo evidence and add-on approval can be explored in the demo. They are not live pilot operations, and no demo action sends a support report or takes payment.

steps.title: Choose the work
steps.description: Explore lawn care, gutter cleaning, pressure washing, and snow removal. Local service coverage still needs confirmation.

steps.title: Bring nearby needs together
steps.description: Neighbors needing similar work may be served together. Whether grouping is practical depends on scope, timing, and provider agreement.

steps.title: Agree before confirming
steps.description: In the intended pilot, an operator reviews availability and coordinates the quote and date. No automatic dispatch or online payment is enabled.
